searchText: Probably want it weighted by volume both in ETH and fiat as well Yep! Gas price is up, so demand should go down. But no. Daily gas supply is up, so gas price should go down, but nope. the fees on ETH will baffle economists for decades to come. Not Austrian economists. 🙂 🤔 Austtrian economics is simple. All market participants have a value preference for a good at any given point in time, and that value preference changes across all market participants at all times (and potentially very rapidly). The Ethereum base fee is just a snapshot of the aggregate value preference for Ethereum blockspace every 15 seconds. https://twitter.com/thegostep/status/1425547669670436866?s=21 *hides* inb4 "name one" imo this is 'new thing bad'. wait a while and there's empirical data for how base fee behaves. can be put into fee estimation. old fee market has literally years of data and estimation development so no surprise it's harder starting from zero.
